source.notes:
IEA Wind Task 43 is part of the IEA Wind Technology Collaboration Programme, and aims to act as a digital transformation catalyst by driving open collaboration within and beyond the wind community to deliver insights, recommendations, standards and tools in the key areas of data, culture, and coopetition. The aim of the IEA Wind Task 43 Culture Questionnaire is to understand how well organisational and team culture in the wind energy sector enables or fosters digitalisation. Any person active in the wind energy sector can participate, and the results will be used anonymously in order to develop recommendations for fostering digitalisation in wind energy through culture. 

The survey questions are published here: https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/IEAWindTask43CultureSurvey2024

This dataset include the answers to the questions, with any data that may identify the respondents removed.
source.title: The IEA Wind Task 43 Culture Questionnaire - raw data
